//: Source manifest for the component registry. `npm run build:dist` expands it into public/r/*.json (the installable registry) and public/llms*.txt. Descriptions here are what models see when browsing the registry.
name: design-system

items.name: design-system
items.title: Design system
items.description: Everything: tokens, component styles, motion and theme helpers, and every component. Install this first.

items.name: accordion
items.description: Several expandable sections. A plus turns into a cross and plain-text answers ease in a word at a time.

items.name: alert
items.description: Persistent message in the page for problems the user must fix.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: Confirmation for irreversible actions.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: Keeps media at a fixed ratio.

items.name: avatar
items.description: A person, with an initials fallback. AvatarGroup lifts faces near the pointer and slides one name label between them.

items.name: badge
items.description: Status label with an optional static dot.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Location in a hierarchy of 3 or more levels.

items.name: button
items.description: Actions. Variants: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link.

items.name: calendar
items.description: Inline date selection.

items.name: card
items.description: One object with its details and actions. `tilt` makes it sink under the pointer.

items.name: carousel
items.description: Horizontally paged content on a turntable: off-centre slides turn away and recede.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: On/off submitted with a form. The check draws itself; a label with data-strike is crossed out.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides one block of secondary detail.

items.name: command
items.description: Search and keyboard selection; the base for combobox and command palette.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: Right-click shortcuts, always duplicated in a visible menu.

items.name: copy-field
items.description: A value with a copy button whose icon turns into a check.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Short focused task that blocks the page.

items.name: drawer
items.description: Bottom panel; replaces dialogs and sheets on phones.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A few actions tied to a button.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: Preview of a linked person or object. Never the only place the info lives.

items.name: input
items.description: Short text field. With `label`, the label rests inside and lifts into the top edge on focus.

items.name: input-group
items.description: Input or textarea with attached buttons or addons.

items.name: input-otp
items.description: Verification code entry. Digits land with a small swell; aria-invalid on the slots shakes the row.

items.name: label
items.description: Visible label for every field.

items.name: menubar
items.description: Application menus.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: Site navigation with nested links.

items.name: number-stepper
items.description: Exact counts between a minus and a plus, with rolling digits and hold to repeat.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Many pages of results. The current page fill slides between pages.

items.name: popover
items.description: Small form or settings tied to a control.

items.name: progress
items.description: Known progress with the value shown, drawn as ticks that light in sequence.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: One choice from up to 5 visible options.

items.name: resizable
items.description: Panels the user can resize.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: Contained scrolling region.

items.name: select
items.description: One choice from about 6 to 15 options. Opens out of the chosen value.

items.name: separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Side panel for editing while keeping the page in view.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.description: Loading status line with a sweeping band of ink.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Placeholder shaped like content that is loading. SkeletonReveal eases the real content in.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.description: A handle pushed across a track for deliberate actions such as publishing.

items.name: slider
items.description: Approximate number in a range, with the value shown. `variant="bars"` is a thumbless bar slider that lifts in a wake when dragged fast.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toaster for results of user actions. Mount once.

items.name: switch
items.description: On/off that applies immediately. The thumb stretches toward where it is going.

items.name: table
items.description: Compare many items across the same fields.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Switch between views of the same thing. The indicator stretches across tabs as it moves; `variant="icons"` shows the name only on the chosen tab.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Long text field.

items.name: toggle
items.description: Single on/off button.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: Segmented on/off options such as formatting or filters. A press shoves neighbours aside.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Names an icon-only button. Never essential information.

items.name: effects
items.title: Special effects
items.description: Border beam and metal surface adapters. Only for explicit requests; never on regular inputs, buttons, or cards.
